item.title: Thunderstorm Advisory No. 3 #MINPRSD
item.description:
Thunderstorm Advisory No. 3 #MINPRSD
Issued at 12:30 AM 29 November 2026

Light to Moderate to Occasionally Heavy rainshowers with lightning and strong winds are expected over #LanaoDelNorte(Maigo, Baroy, Tangcal), #MisamisOccidental(OzamisCity, Clarin, TangubCity), #SurigaoDelSur(Carrascal, Hinatuan), #SurigaoDelNorte(Claver), #ZamboangaCity and #ZamboangaSibugay(Tungawan) within the next 1-2 hours.

The above conditions are being experienced in #LanaoDelNorte(Kolambugan, Magsaysay, Tubod), #ZamboangaSibugay(Talusan, Mabuhay, Olutanga), #DavaoOriental(Baganga, Cateel), #SurigaoDelSur(Lingig, CityOfBislig), #SurigaoDelNorte(SurigaoCity and TaganaAn) which may persist within 1-2 hours and may affect nearby areas.

All are advised to take precautionary measures against the impacts associated with these hazards which include flash floods and landslides.

Keep monitoring for updates.
